# @rnw-community/react-native-screen-chrome

> Composable, safe-area-aware screen chrome for React Native and React Native Web: collapsible titles, persistent
> navigation controls, progressive edge fades, and content insets around one scrollable. Motion, scroll wiring, and
> snapping are delegated to the peer `@rnw-community/react-native-collapsible-header`; other peers are
> `react-native-reanimated`, `react-native-safe-area-context`, `@react-native-masked-view/masked-view`, `expo-blur`
> (>=55 <59), and `expo-linear-gradient`.

Mount one `ScreenChromeProvider` per scrollable inside each screen, never once around a navigator, and resolve exactly
one copy of the collapsible header. Render content first, decorative fades and backdrop second, `CollapsibleHeader` last.

## Landing

- [readme.md](readme.md): Installation, complete example, paint order, compound header contract, and full public API.

## Guides

- [Installation](readme.md#installation): Required peer dependencies and why the collapsible header must resolve to a single copy.
- [Complete example](readme.md#complete-example): Provider, frame, scroll view, fades, and compound header composed into one screen.
- [Structure and paint order](readme.md#structure-and-paint-order): Provider ownership, one provider per scrollable, and layer ordering.
- [Compound header contract](readme.md#compound-header-contract): Required direct-child slot order and the render-time `TypeError` on violations.
- [Edge fades](readme.md#edge-fades): Native masked-gradient blur versus web CSS mask and backdrop-filter behavior.
- [Configuration and snapping](readme.md#configuration-and-snapping): Deep-merge rules, threshold ordering, and `snapToCollapse` requirements.

## API reference

- [`CollapsibleHeader`](readme.md#collapsibleheader): Compound collapsible header composing control and title slots into the generic collapsible-header primitive, with optional `motion` overrides.
- [`CollapsibleHeaderSlot`](readme.md#collapsibleheaderslot): Persistent leading or trailing control slot mounted once above both title layers.
- [`CollapsibleHeaderTitleSlot`](readme.md#collapsibleheadertitleslot): Groups the expanded and collapsed title layers of a compound header.
- [`CollapsibleHeaderBackdrop`](readme.md#collapsibleheaderbackdrop): Top `EdgeFade` sized to `headerBackdropHeight` and aligned with the title-collapse thresholds.
- [`EdgeFade`](readme.md#edgefade): Decorative top or bottom blur band, scroll-animatable through `scrollAnimation`, with opt-in Android blur via `blurTarget`.
- [`EdgeFadePropsInterface`](readme.md#edgefadepropsinterface): Props accepted by `EdgeFade`.
- [`EdgeFadeScrollAnimationInterface`](readme.md#edgefadescrollanimationinterface): Scroll-driven opacity and blur intensity ranges for an edge fade.
- [`EdgeFadePosition`](readme.md#edgefadeposition): `'top' | 'bottom'` screen edge of a fade band.
- [`ScreenChromeMaskStopInterface`](readme.md#screenchromemaskstopinterface): One color stop in an edge-fade mask.
- [`ScreenChromeFrame`](readme.md#screenchromeframe): Relative full-screen layout root for content, fades, and header chrome.
- [`ScreenChromeHeader`](readme.md#screenchromeheader): Static, non-collapsible header row with the same safe-area and paint-order contract.
- [`ScreenChromeProvider`](readme.md#screenchromeprovider): Provides validated configuration and color scheme around one scrollable and mounts the collapsible-header provider.
- [`ScreenChromeScrollView`](readme.md#screenchromescrollview): Animated scroll view wired to the collapsible-header scroll handling with safe-area content padding and `contentInsetMode`.
- [`useBottomChromeHeightPublisher`](readme.md#usebottomchromeheightpublisher): Publishes a measured or declared bottom chrome height, such as a custom tab bar's, for `useBottomChromeInset`.
- [`BottomChromeHeightPublisherOptionsInterface`](readme.md#bottomchromeheightpublisheroptionsinterface): Declared `height` that replaces measurement and survives hidden chrome.
- [`BottomChromeHeightPublisherInterface`](readme.md#bottomchromeheightpublisherinterface): `{ ref, onLayout }` view props that measure the bottom chrome node.
- [`ScreenChromeContext`](readme.md#screenchromecontext): React context carrying the resolved `{ colorScheme, config }` value.
- [`useScreenChrome`](readme.md#usescreenchrome): Reads the nearest screen chrome context and throws without a provider.
- [`useScrollFadeStyle`](readme.md#usescrollfadestyle): Clamped opacity style interpolated from the provider scroll value.
- [`getScreenChromeHeaderMetrics`](readme.md#getscreenchromeheadermetrics): Pure computation of the rendered header footprint from header height, device top inset, and optional extra inset.
- [`useScreenChromeHeaderMetrics`](readme.md#usescreenchromeheadermetrics): Header footprint for the live provider config and device insets.
- [`ScreenChromeColorScheme`](readme.md#screenchromecolorscheme): Resolved `'light' | 'dark'` palette every chrome consumer reads from the context.
- [`ScreenChromeColorSchemePreference`](readme.md#screenchromecolorschemepreference): Provider `colorScheme` input — a fixed scheme or `'system'`, resolved at render from `useColorScheme()`.
- [`ScreenChromeColorSetInterface`](readme.md#screenchromecolorsetinterface): Solid and translucent wash colors for one color scheme.
- [`ScreenChromeConfigInterface`](readme.md#screenchromeconfiginterface): Full chrome geometry, colors, fade masks, scroll throttling, and collapse thresholds.
- [`ScreenChromeConfigOverridesInterface`](readme.md#screenchromeconfigoverridesinterface): Partial overrides accepted by the provider `config` prop, preserving nested colors and mask stops.
- [`ScreenChromeContextValueInterface`](readme.md#screenchromecontextvalueinterface): The `{ colorScheme, config }` shape returned by `useScreenChrome`.
- [`SCREEN_CHROME_DEFAULT_CONFIG`](readme.md#screen_chrome_default_config): Platform default config (native and web variants) that `mergeScreenChromeConfig` starts from.
- [`SCREEN_CHROME_SHARED_DEFAULT_CONFIG`](readme.md#screen_chrome_shared_default_config): Platform-independent subset of the default config shared by native and web.
- [`assertValidScreenChromeConfig`](readme.md#assertvalidscreenchromeconfig): Throws a property-specific error for configs that cannot drive stable scroll animations.
- [`mergeScreenChromeConfig`](readme.md#mergescreenchromeconfig): Resolves partial overrides into a complete immutable config, deep-merging `colors` and `maskStops`.
- [`mergeRefs`](readme.md#mergerefs): Fans one instance out to several object or function refs with React 19 cleanup handling.
- [`ScrollContentInsetMode`](readme.md#scrollcontentinsetmode): `'replace' | 'additive'` selector for how chrome padding meets consumer padding.
- [`addScrollContentInset`](readme.md#addscrollcontentinset): Stacks safe-area and chrome padding on top of consumer `paddingTop` / `paddingBottom`.
- [`mergeScrollContentInset`](readme.md#mergescrollcontentinset): Prepends safe-area and chrome padding while letting consumer styles win.
